title: Ketones in urine and blood at home
what: At home, you check ketones with urine strips or with a meter and a drop of blood. Ketones appear when your body does not have enough insulin or food.
why: With diabetes: when blood sugar is high, and when you are sick, vomiting, or have a fever. Sometimes on strict diets, on a doctor's advice.
tell_doctor: How often your ketones are high
If you use an insulin pump
If you take diabetes tablets. Some of them raise ketones even with normal sugar

prepare.title: Plan
prepare.text: Ask your doctor for a plan ahead of time: when to check ketones and what to do for each result.

prepare.title: Supplies
prepare.text: Keep urine strips, or a meter with test strips, at home. Check the expiry dates.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Do not stop or change anything on your own. Doses with ketones only as your doctor's plan says.

bring: Urine strips or a blood meter
steps: For urine: wet the strip in urine or hold it in the stream
Wait the time in the instructions, then compare the color with the chart on the package
For blood: wash and dry your hands
Put a ketone strip into the meter and prick your finger
Touch the drop of blood to the strip and wait for the result
Write down the result with your blood sugar and the time
feel: Blood test: a quick finger prick
after: Follow the plan your doctor gave you
With high ketones, people usually drink more water and check sugar and ketones more often
If you have no plan, call your doctor
red_flags: High ketones with vomiting or belly pain: call your doctor or emergency services
Fast, deep breathing, a fruity acetone smell on the breath, severe sleepiness, or confusion: call emergency services
A child with diabetes is drowsy, vomiting, and has ketones: call emergency services

faq.q: Which is more accurate, urine or blood?
faq.a: Blood shows ketones right now. Urine shows them with a delay. If you have a meter, blood is better for making decisions.

faq.q: I have ketones but my sugar is normal. Is that dangerous?
faq.a: It can happen from not eating. But with some diabetes medicines, it is dangerous. Call your doctor.

reminders.text: High blood sugar or feeling sick? Check your ketones and follow your doctor's plan.
